function: Two-stage CNN estimation of the dual-reflection cascaded channel of a reference user, then of the other users' scaling vectors, in double-RIS uplink MIMO (p. 3).
system: Uplink; BS with P=22 antennas, K=4 single-antenna users, two passive reflecting RISs (a fixed, b adjustable) of 20 elements each; frequency band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: Supervised CNN (conv 128 and 64 filters, max-pooling, dense 512), Adam, trained on simulated pilots, two stages: reference user, then other users (pp. 3, 4).
data_channel: Own simulator: Gaussian-perturbed channel matrices (Algorithm 1), path loss -30 dB at 1 m, exponents 2.2-2.8, 180,000 samples; no 3GPP model or measurements (p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained over SNR -5 to 30 dB; tested on 20% held-out samples and new pilot data; K=4, P=22, Na=Nb=20 throughout; no unseen configuration (pp. 4, 5).
baselines: Non-learned: LS and the double-RIS estimator of [12]; learned: SRCNN [9], ODE-CNN [10], DBPN [11], and a curve labeled NN (Figs. 4, 5; pp. 4, 5).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR against benchmarks (Figs. 4, 5); complexity order; training about 20 min, testing 0.003 s (pp. 4, 5).
complexity: O(Nb^3 + P Nb^2 + P Ta Q), Q being fixed CNN FLOPs; training about 20 min, testing 0.003 s (pp. 4, 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "the path loss for a reference distance of 1m" - path loss plus Gaussian-perturbed channel matrices of Algorithm 1 from the authors' own simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "Except otherwise specified, the simulations used K = 4," P = 22, Na = Nb = 20; one setup for training and test (80%/20% split of 180000 samples, SNR -5 to 30 dB); Figs. 4 and 5 sweep SNR only, so no other configuration, band or dataset is tested.
q3_support: p. 5: "existing deep learning methods as illustrated in Fig. 4" - SRCNN [9], ODE-CNN [10], DBPN [11] on NMSE; Fig. 5 (p. 5) compares with the non-learned benchmark of [12], called "benchmark LS method" on p. 4.
q4_support: p. 4: "where Q represents the fixed FLOPs from CNN operations" - order O(Nb^3 + P Nb^2 + P Ta Q), compared in Table I; p. 5: "The training takes about 20 min and the testing takes only" 0.003 seconds.
q5_support: p. 3: "generated by producing multiple realizations based on the proposed framework" - data come from the authors' own simulator (Algorithm 1, p. 4); no code or data link or DOI, no public dataset, no measurements.
notes: Include, area 2 (channel estimation, RIS and multi-antenna BS present, NMSE results on p. 5). Frequency band is not stated. The curve labeled NN in Fig. 4 is not defined in the text. The training text names both the ADAM optimizer and stochastic gradient descent with momentum (p. 4). q1 is 0 because the channel statistics are generated by Algorithm 1 around base realizations that the paper does not tie to any standard model. q2 is 0 because Figs. 4 and 5 only sweep SNR and the test set is a held-out part of the same data.
